summary: Tested merged-position feature end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed for PATCH /api/posizioni/stato covering 401 (no token), 403 (office token), 404 (unknown position), case-insensitive matching that updates ALL pedane with same numeroOrdine+codice (worker name stamped), isolation (different codice in same order and same codice in different order are NOT touched), annulla reset, and parziale with note. Frontend: merged UI verified at viewport 390x844 - search auto-opens detail card listing both merci (pedana-detail-merce-list with 2 items), group summary shows '2 posizioni · 3 pedane · 188 colli' with merged row's n°pedane=2 and n°colli=168, 'magazzino-multi-merce-{id}' pill shows '2 merci'; worker login flow works; tapping stato-segna-completo-button once sets both pedane to completo with 'da {worker}' label; stato-annulla-button resets both back to attesa.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (RN deprecation). Not blocking, but should migrate. Likely in Sheet/overlay component.

action_items: Optional: migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN deprecation warning
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/posizioni/stato uses case-insensitive regex for codice but exact (case-sensitive) match for numeroOrdine - matches frontend mergePositions key which lowercases only codice. Correct behavior.
mergePositions key uses codice.trim().toLowerCase() which aligns with backend regex ^codice$ case-insensitive match.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted (within tests + manual UI seed): TEST order TESTDED37A with 3 pedane, a second TEST order sharing codice (backend test only), and TEST worker TEST_UI_a0f8/TEST_W_* with PIN 1234. All test data cleaned up afterward.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Default Magazzino filter is 'Da scaricare' (attesa) and switches to 'Tutte' when searching. When a search yields exactly one merged position (same numeroOrdine+codice), the detail card auto-opens. PATCH /api/posizioni/stato endpoint takes {numeroOrdine, codice, stato, noteParziale} with Bearer magazzino token and returns List[Pedana].
rca_of_issue: N/A - feature verified working as specified.
